summary: FBS Global Ltd, a Singapore-based Nasdaq-listed construction contractor, filed a 6-K disclosing shareholder approval of a one-for-ten reverse share consolidation at its September 13, 2026 extraordinary general meeting. The consolidation, recommended by the board, will be effected upon Nasdaq clearance, with split-adjusted trading expected from September 28, 2026 under symbol FBGL and new CUSIP G3337S117. Outstanding shares fall from 13,500,000 to roughly 1,350,000, par value rises from US$0.001 to US$0.01, ownership proportions are unchanged, and no fractional shares are issued. The move targets Nasdaq's US$1.00 minimum bid requirement; watch for compliance confirmation and any residual delisting risk if the bid fails to hold.
